item.title: ‘Please Save Cricket’: Bangladesh cricketers plead as another controversy grips BCB; Full story here
item.description: A suspension, a protest, and then silence. As a key BCB figure returns, players warn the sport is heading towards deeper turmoil behind closed doors.

item.title: Weather Update: Snowfall disrupts life in hills; Cold wave tightens grip across India
item.description: Severe winter conditions continue across India on January 27, disrupting daily life in several states. Heavy snowfall has led to the closure of the Srinagar–Jammu highway, while Uttarakhand battles blocked roads and power issues.

item.title: Delhi braces for Beating Retreat Full Dress Rehearsal; Traffic curbs announced
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police has issued a special advisory ahead of the full dress rehearsal for the Beating Retreat ceremony at Vijay Chowk on January 27. Vehicular movement will be restricted on several key roads between 4 pm and 6 pm.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: Pakistan’s black armband plan sparks fresh controversy; ICC guidelines explained
item.description: Ahead of the T20 World Cup 2026, Pakistan finds itself at the centre of a fresh controversy. Reports suggest the team may wear black armbands to support Bangladesh, raising questions over ICC regulations.

item.title: Gig workers go on Nationwide app switch-off; Plan street protests on 3 Feb
item.description: Gig and platform service workers across India staged a nationwide online strike by switching off their apps, protesting alleged exploitation, income insecurity, and arbitrary ID blocking. The protest, led largely by women workers, spans sectors like ride-hailing, food delivery, and e-commerce.

item.title: Stock Market opens lower after holiday; Sensex, Nifty under pressure
item.description: Indian equity markets opened on a weak note after the Republic Day holiday. In early trade around 9:15 am, the Sensex declined nearly 380 points from its previous close, while the Nifty 50 slipped below the 25,050 mark.

item.title: Record-Breaking Rally: Gold, Silver shine bright amid global tensions; Check today’s rates here
item.description: Gold and silver prices surged sharply as geopolitical tensions and a weak US dollar boosted safe-haven demand. International gold traded above $5,000 per ounce, while silver hovered near record highs.

item.title: UGC rules will be fair for all, Ministry to clarify confusions; Full details inside
item.description: The new UGC rules have sparked protests across India, with general category organizations expressing concerns over representation in the complaint committee. The government has assured that the norms will be fair and equitable for all. Education Ministry is set to issue clarification to resolve confusions.

item.title: India-EU FTA: Modi Calls it ‘Mother of All Deals’ at India Energy Week; Details inside
item.description: At India Energy Week 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the historic India-EU Free Trade Agreement, calling it the “Mother of All Deals.” The FTA is expected to boost trade, investment, manufacturing, and employment, strengthening India’s role in the global economy.
